request: Is every equipment item protected by a relief device? List the sides that are not and what you would do.
headline: No - coolers, pump and tank unprotected

gaps.what: Adding relief protection for the unprotected sides (H1007 both sides, H1008 both sides, T4750 vent, H1008 isolation by 47126/C7)
gaps.why: The spec has no PSV/vent/thermal-expansion physics; relief protection cannot be expressed as a path change, add_unit pump/hx/valve, or reroute, so no verified proposal can be returned for this fix
gaps.needed: A relief-device / vent unit type in the flowsheet spec (set pressure, relieving capacity, connections) so adding thermal relief valves and tank vents can be proposed as model changes and re-solved

request: Calculate the noise level at the compressor or pump nearest the control room.
headline: Noise level cannot be calculated here

gaps.what: Adding relief protection for the unprotected sides (H1007 both sides, H1008 both sides, T4750 vent, H1008 isolation by 47126/C7)
gaps.why: The spec has no PSV/vent/thermal-expansion physics; relief protection cannot be expressed as a path change, add_unit pump/hx/valve, or reroute, so no verified proposal can be returned for this fix
gaps.needed: A relief-device / vent unit type in the flowsheet spec (set pressure, relieving capacity, connections) so adding thermal relief valves and tank vents can be proposed as model changes and re-solved

gaps.what: noise level at the pump nearest the control room
gaps.why: P&ID C01 and data sheet give only pump hydraulics and motor kW (P4711 2.2 kW, P4712 7.5 kW) with no sound power data, no control-room location, and no pump-to-room distances. The DWSIM spec has pump/hx/valve/tank/mixer/splitter/recycle physics only, no acoustic or sound-propagation calculation, so noise cannot be solved from a logged run. Estimating from motor size alone would be inventing ratings.
gaps.needed: Acoustic source data and layout: vendor sound power/pressure levels for P4711 and P4712 at duty, distance and direction from each pump to control room, plot plan, control-room wall construction and background level, plus an acoustic propagation model in the flowsheet spec.
